title: Custom SaaS Builds
meta: The core of a SaaS product: accounts, subscription billing and a dashboard, built to grow with you. From $450, delivered in 7 days or less.
h1: SaaS product foundations: accounts, billing and dashboards
overview: We build the parts every software product needs before it can take its first paying customer: user accounts, a plan and billing system, and a dashboard that shows people their own data. We agree your plans and key screens first, then build on a modern stack and deploy it to your own hosting. The code and the payment account are yours, so the product can grow without being tied to us.

pkgs.blurb: Accounts, one paid plan and a simple dashboard.

pkgs.blurb: Several plans, team accounts and billing self service.
A fuller product shell with admin, analytics and automated tests.

faq: Do you build my actual product idea too?
We build the foundations around it. The Premium package includes up to 2 core product screens. Larger product features are built in later stages that we quote separately.
Which payment provider do you use?
Stripe by default, set up in your own Stripe account so that money goes straight to you. We never hold your funds. If you prefer another provider, tell us in the order.
Can the product handle many users?
We build on common, scalable tools and keep the structure clean. We do not promise specific traffic numbers. We note any limits in the handover.
Who owns the code and customer data?
You do. Code, database and payment account are all in your own accounts. We hand over everything and no part is locked to us.
